title: Scratch register lookup
statement: Let a state consist of seven natural-number registers: depth, assignment stack, input pointer, scratch copy, copy-loop scratch register, halving counter, and current-literal variable. In the register vector ordered by these registers, the entry at index $4$ equals the value of the scratch register.
hypotheses_covered: the state is a record of seven natural-number registers
